# Finance table contract

Every permanent tab renders one primary `AppListTable`.

## Baseline columns

Add where applicable: Select, human-friendly Reference, Facility, Status, Created At, Created By, Updated At, Updated By, and Actions. Monetary tables also expose Currency.

## Required behavior

- Server search, filters, sorting, and pagination
- Sticky header and frozen identifying columns
- Column picker, reordering, density, and saved views
- Filtered server subtotals/grand totals
- Export and print using all matching permitted rows
- Responsive horizontal scrolling for wide tables
- Localized labels, dates, statuses, empty states, and errors
- No raw UUID/database IDs
- Active tab count from filtered total; inactive badge from summary
- Targeted row/count refresh after a mutation

Default columns are intentionally compact; every source-of-truth column remains selectable and exportable.
